items.summary: SL2T is our amazing sign-language-to-text model allows users to sign directly to their phones for the first time. Built in close collaboration with the Deaf community, it’s a great example of the good that can be done with AI. Congrats to the team for the launch! Google DeepMind (@GoogleDeepMind) SL2T is our breakthrough sign language-to-text model powering new features for Deaf and hard of hearing users on @Android . Starting with American Sign Language-to-English on Pixel 11, people can sign directly into Gboard and Live Transcribe instead of typing.
